description.value:
You've blended twinblade fighting with your spellcasting. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you use your action to cast a power that calls for a weapon attack while wielding a weapon with the light and double properties in two hands, you can use your bonus action to engage in Double-Weapon Fighting, following all its normal rules.

system.requirements: 4th level, the ability to cast force or tech powers.
